meta.name: calendly-automation
meta.description: Automate Calendly scheduling, event management, invitee tracking, availability checks, and organization administration via Rube MCP (Composio). Always search tools first for current schemas.

copy.tagline: 自动管理日程安排、跟踪与会者与可用性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要处理Calendly日程的创建、修改和与会者跟踪。
copy.tagline_en: Automate scheduling, event management, and invitee tracking in Calendly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently manage Calendly events, availability, and invitee tracking.

howto.what: Claude 可以查看、取消你的 Calendly 活动，管理参与者，创建预约链接，检查空闲时段，以及管理组织成员和邀请。
howto.when: 当你要求查看或管理 Calendly 日程、参与者、预约链接或组织时触发。

say.text: 帮我列出我下周的 Calendly 活动。
say.note: Claude 会获取当前用户并列出指定时间范围的活动。

say.text: 取消我明天下午3点的 Calendly 会议。
say.note: Claude 会先确认活动详情，再执行取消操作。

say.text: 创建一个单次使用的预约链接。
say.note: Claude 会获取你的活动类型并生成链接。

howto.what_en: Claude can view and cancel your Calendly events, manage invitees, create scheduling links, check availability, and manage organization members and invitations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to view or manage Calendly schedules, participants, booking links, or organization settings.

say_en.text: List my Calendly events for next week.
say_en.note: Claude fetches current user and lists events in the time range.

say_en.text: Cancel my Calendly meeting at 3 PM tomorrow.
say_en.note: Claude confirms event details before cancellation.
Claude retrieves your event types and generates a link.
